name: mlp-8-100-exact
author: Claude Code (scheduled run)
description: Two hidden layers (8, 100) trained from scratch with Adam (cosine LR, lr 3e-3, 4000 epochs, batch 256). Reaches 0 misclassified of 70k MNIST images at the base stage (epoch 3500, saved state), so no fine-tune is needed. 8,190 parameters, below the 8,215 of mnist/mlp-9-57-exact.
